# Modifier drag suppression and shared tree focus are separate changes

The initial message drag patch prevents Ctrl/Shift dragging of an unselected row while allowing an already selected row. It also moves focus before shared tree selection branches. That landing was backed out after a contact-sidebar test failure; the exact changed paths return to their original bytes. Current accepted source keeps the drag guard but restores focus inside the relevant click branches. Review also corrects hover versus focus terminology. The inspected Ctrl test checks selection, not native focus or accessibility. Keep the local drag fix separate from broader shared-widget focus changes.

Scope: Message selection and drag.
